I am happy every day. My friend Max is very kind. The tea house is big and clean. Let's watch a movie tonight.
After school, we play together. The noodle shop is not far from my home. Max often helps me with art. Best of all, there are forty desks in our new classroom.
We talk about art a lot. Nina goes to the gym on Thursday. Nina usually eats dumplings for lunch.
